title: switch on Strings
hints: `switch` works on `String` values, and a case can list several strings.
Lowercase first; use `case let f where f.hasPrefix("storm")` for prefixes.
jsBridge: JS `switch` on strings uses `===`. Swift pattern-matches strings too, and adds `case let s where s.hasPrefix("storm")`, so switch can do what JS needs an `if` chain for.
